**Where it's opened**
- The **Inventory** button at `game-console.component.html:9` calls `openInventory()` (`frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts:237`).
- That function builds `dialogData` (`:238`) and calls `MatDialog.open(InventoryComponent, { data, panelClass: 'inv-dialog-panel', maxHeight: '90vh' })` (`:242`).

**Data passed**
- `InventoryDialogData = { characterId, sessionId }`, declared at `inventory/inventory.component.ts:19`.
- `InventoryComponent` injects it via `MAT_DIALOG_DATA` (`:41`).

**API calls the dialog can make**
All go through `GameApiService` (`frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts`).

| Action | Component method | Service method | Endpoint |
|---|---|---|---|
| Load on open | `ngOnInit` (`:53`) | `getInventory` (`:90`) | `GET /api/character/:id` (`worker/src/routes/character.ts:72`) |
| Equip / unequip | `toggleEquip` (`:72`) | `equipItem` (`:96`) | `PATCH /api/character/:id/equip` (`character.ts:93`) |
| Use potion | `usePotion` (`:96`) | `dropItem` | `DELETE /api/character/:id/inventory/:itemId` |
| Drop | `dropItem` (`:144`) | `dropItem` (`:100`) | `DELETE /api/character/:id/inventory/:itemId` (`character.ts:137`) |

After loading, `ngOnInit` copies the result into `CharacterStateService.setInventory`.

**Caveats noted in the docs**
- Using a potion rolls the heal dice in the browser and sets HP locally only. It is never saved (B-05). The only server call is the item delete.
- Equipping is display-only, because combat ignores equipment (B-08).
- The dialog makes no shop calls. The shop endpoints (`GET /api/shop/:id` and `POST /api/shop/transaction`) exist on the Worker but have no UI.

I read `docs/flows/inventory.md` in full. I also grepped the code, which confirmed the import, `dialogData` and `MAT_DIALOG_DATA` references. I did not open the code to verify the other line numbers and endpoints, so those come from the docs.
